prompt: A compound with formula C₄H₈O shows: IR 1715 cm⁻¹ (strong), no O–H; ¹H NMR 2.1 ppm (s, 3H), 2.5 ppm (q, 2H), 1.0 ppm (t, 3H). Identify it.
explanation: IR 1715 (ketone C=O), no O–H rules out alcohol. The methyl singlet (α to C=O), ethyl quartet+triplet pattern, and absence of an aldehyde H (δ ~9.7) nail it as 2-butanone.
